classification: read-only source audit plus archived #385 replay; diagnostic only; no runtime or flight change

finding.summary: The archived +0.5 s and +1.25 s raw sphere queries sampled a sphere fully inside the injected box interior, not its visible front face. A raw free result there does not establish whether the front surface was marked occupied or inflated.

source_semantics.fact: /mapping/query_occupancy_sphere classifies raw occupancy_buffer_ cells intersecting the requested sphere; it does not inspect inflation.
SphereQuery.h documents closed-sphere raw-cell intersection and no inflation.
raycastProcess marks traversed camera-to-return cells free and the in-range depth return endpoint occupied; it does not fill the physical volume behind the return surface.
clearAndInflateLocalMap rebuilds occupancy_buffer_inflate_ from raw occupied cells; raw occupancy and inflated occupancy are separate layers.

With official_ego_collision_policy enabled, getInflateOccupancy uses the inflated mask alone; the native optimizer and checkCollisionCallback use that predicate. The read-only /mapping/query_planning_occupancy endpoint exposes a point query to that predicate, radius must be zero, and does not publish control.
queryReadiness checks active epoch/map identity, fused depth and pose state; project-local source-age cutoffs were removed by patch 0054. Native EGO odom/depth timeout remains.

limits_and_conclusion: Because the archived query sphere sits entirely inside the spawned box and is about 0.272 m behind its x-negative face, its free=160 result can coexist with a correctly occupied front return surface and says nothing direct about the inflated value at that surface.

The #385 archive has no box-face raw occupied point coordinates or same-time /mapping/query_planning_occupancy point result. Existing occupied-cloud ROI points are from a separate static-cylinder observation.

Thus #388 explains why the interior raw query is not by itself proof of a map/collision failure, but cannot determine from archived data whether the injected box surface was actually observed and inflated in #385. Dynamic-obstacle causality remains unqualified.
No runtime rejection gate was added, no flight was run, and no previous flight evidence was modified.
